title: What will BlackRock, Inc. say during their next earnings call? Digital Asset
rules: If Digital Asset is said by any BlackRock, Inc. representative (including the operator of the call) during the next BlackRock, Inc. earnings call (including the Q+A), then the market resolves to Yes.

blind.reasoning: BlackRock's Q3 2026 call is scheduled for October 14, before the market closes. Executives said 'digital assets' repeatedly on the Q2 2026 and Q1 2026 calls, and they have set a public $500M digital-asset revenue goal they are likely to report on. Analysts also ask about tokenization regularly, so the phrase will very likely come up in the prepared remarks or the Q&A.
blind.falsifier: The Q3 2026 call happens but no BlackRock representative says 'digital asset(s)', using only terms like crypto, tokenization or bitcoin, or the call is postponed past Oct 27.

final.reasoning: The phrase 'digital assets' came up on both the Q1 and Q2 2026 calls, and BlackRock has a public $500M digital-asset revenue target it is likely to update on October 14. The market at about 0.90 underprices this, though I trimmed my estimate slightly for wording risk.
